name: Iroha
source:
One of the candidates to become the next demon king that is found by Akatsuki of the Four Heavenly Kings.
A 2nd year high schooler that has the best grades in school, his reflexes are great and he's pretty enough that everybody envies him, he meets all three conditions to be a perfect person.
However his personality is terrible and he has no motivation, he always takes an attitude.
He has no sense of cooperation and is always skipping class, and even when he does go to school he is napping in the back garden and not taking anything seriously.
